subject: Can someone help to review the change to fix the pairwise and Bernoulli distribution?

messages.author: 3a33a4d3c6b9f730
messages.subject: Can someone help to review the change to fix the pairwise and Bernoulli distribution?
parts:
https://github.com/gbm-developers/gbm/pull/80

Recently introduced issues cause this two distributions don't function properly.
  1. For the pairwise, ComputerLambda() is not working - adZ[] updating has been commented out unless NOISY_DEBUG is defined. This means the pairwise distribution is not functioning unless the GBM is complied with the NOISY_DEBUG flag.
  2. For the Bernoulli: in InitF() its Newton method termination condition is incomplete: most likely it will terminate after one iteration. And since the commit[1], adOffset[] is not NULL in all cases; so the Newton process always is applied. The model will need more trees to fit the problem because of the unoptimized initialization.

They still exist after the major refactor change in #79
